owned-simulacra-repair.head: 55f1b05b5b8e86cad4613b81e347e90e77920c0d
owned-simulacra-repair.scope: Stock activated all five repairs on an owned Fortified proxy with room for every heal. The casts requested +20, +34, +117, +174 and +83 respectively. Stock sent a request with QAFriend selected for 30 and 615, and the server refused both. The companion disposable bootstrap checks each actual delta, retained maximum, FX, reuse and player-target denial.

behavior-tests.source: Shipped ability 30 has a fixed type-3 health value of 20, the own-pet target check and a 13s reuse.
behavior-tests.runtime: CoderPets resolves ownership, computes FixedHeal from the caster, applies HealPet and publishes its effect and window health. AbilityCooldowns provides the individual reuse.
behavior-tests.test: AbilityEvidencePetRepairsMode checks the exact pet HP delta, maximum, FX, own reuse record and player-target refusal for every variant. Stock run: https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/333#issuecomment-7008336031
